profile.summary: Mandela Partners is an Oakland nonprofit that works with local residents, family farmers and community-based businesses on local food enterprises in low-income communities. Its programs include produce distribution through community supported agriculture (CSA) boxes and community stands, culinary job training, support for food entrepreneurs, and wellness and nutrition education.
